decisions.reason: As a newly launched but infrastructure-related fabricated metal product, a sewer pipe cleaning box is close enough to the firm's capabilities that management would usually give it more time unless demand proves clearly weak.
Public waste bins fit well with a German metal fabricator serving municipal or public-space customers, so a recent launch would normally be retained while sales channels develop.
Ground sleeves for posts are a straightforward, adjacent metal product with broad practical use, making it likely the firm keeps them in the catalogue after only one year.
Cast iron ground sleeves are more specialized and could face overlap with other sleeve variants, but management would still be more likely to keep than drop them so soon after launch.
Steel ground sleeves are a natural fit for a fabricated metal producer and likely the preferred variant for the firm's manufacturing base, so they would usually stay on the market.
